chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:

No believer supplicates for the believing men and women, and the Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead, but that Allah writes for him a good deed for every believer and believing woman, from when Allah sent forth Adam until the Hour is established.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for supplicating for believers and Muslims?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) emphasizes the enduring nature of this reward, noting that a single act of supplication for the community yields a distinct good deed for every believer from the creation of Adam until the Day of Judgment. This highlights the concept of 'continuous charity' (Sadaqah Jariyah) in Shia tradition, where the spiritual bond between the living and the dead is maintained through intercessory prayer, reflecting the collective responsibility of the Ummah.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2. And from the previous chain from Abi al-Hassan al-Ridha (a.s.) who said: “

No believer supplicates for a living or dead believing men and women and Muslim men and women but that the Almighty Allah writes for him the reward of the good deeds of all believers from Adam (a.s.) till Qiyamat.”
